summary.text: David Fabrikant, an attorney and write-in candidate with no party affiliation, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 21st Congressional District to Brian Mast.
He says he has practiced law for 25 years and spent the past 15 helping people with financial difficulties.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Fabrikant graduated from Hollywood Hills High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida in 1997.
He earned a law degree from St. Thomas University in 2000 and has worked as an attorney.
He says he has 25 years of legal experience, including 15 years helping people who are struggling with their finances.
Fabrikant describes himself as a 50-year-old married father of two teenagers.
His Candidate Connection survey listed seven proposed laws he had drafted, including tying the minimum wage to congressional salaries and basing committee selection on seniority.
He lost to Brian Mast, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
